issues.issue: Whether the father's political profile and embassy dismissal make the claimant a persecution target
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says her father was a political figure in France and embassy staff suspected her of opposition ties.
issues.result_text: Panel not persuaded persecution is likely on return; claimant's testimony untrustworthy.

issues.issue: Whether the 2009 warning email and travel timing support the claim
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says a warning email after arrival prompted her claim and she travelled to Canada on holiday.
issues.result_text: Not reasonable she travelled less than a week before the return date if suspected; email given little weight.

issues.issue: Whether the family's treatment in Ethiopia shows a risk of persecution
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says family suffered only calls and questioning, and her mother was allowed to travel to France.
issues.result_text: Panel not persuaded claimant has good grounds to fear persecution; calls and questioning are not ill-treatment.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's subjective fear is undermined by not seeking protection in France
issues.applicant_position: Claimant argues France would have disallowed any claim diplomatically because of her employer.
issues.result_text: Claimant has not established subjective fear, having not sought protection in France for four years.

issues.issue: Whether the principal claimant's return with political literature supports his fear
issues.applicant_position: Principal claimant says he carried literature at his mother's insistence and denies political involvement.
issues.result_text: Principal claimant not credible; cumulative credibility concerns defeat the claim.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces torture or cruel treatment on return
issues.result_text: Claimant is not a person in need of protection.
